title: Eat, walk and discover the beauty of Barcelona.
text: As a frequent Barcelona traveler the city is not new to me. I’m happy to say that Valentín also took us outside of the busy (touristic) areas. It’s not only about food but also about the history and culture of the city. The weather really played along as well, uncontrollable but a plus. Communication before and during the tour was top-notch.
author: Lucy_H
